remarks: Tucked away at the end of a long private driveway in the prestigious Old Hill neighborhood, this extraordinary like-new home is the ultimate year-round retreat - offering resort-style amenities, sophisticated design and effortless everyday living. Front-to-back foyer immediately draws your eye to the backyard oasis & solar-heated pool beyond. Elegant formal living and dining rooms flank the entry, seamlessly flowing into the heart of the home: an expansive newly renovated kitchen & family room designed for both grand entertaining and relaxed gatherings. Appointed with high-end appliances, butler's pantry, coffee bar, fireplace & walls of glass sliders opening to the patio; the space transitions beautifully to an outdoor entertaining area complete with overhead trellis, outdoor kitchen, swing set, climbing sphere surrounded by expansive professionally landscaped grounds.
